topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I can't believe this is happening. The flight update just came in – another delay, and now there's no chance I'll make it. I've been refreshing the app every few minutes, hoping for some miracle update that doesn't come. The event is too important, and I've been dreading this moment. It's like everything is slipping away, and there’s nothing I can do. I keep pacing around the airport, checking my watch, hoping somehow time will move differently for me. But it won't. I should call and tell them, but the words won’t form. This is a nightmare.
